This "song of ascent" is a prayer for exaltation above worldly dangers. The "hills, from whence cometh my help" are the mountains of the Lord's house; thus it is made clear that "my help cometh from the Lord" (Ps. 121:1-2). This psalm, which is almost as well known as Psalm 23, "The Lord is my shepherd," gives the same assurance of protection in the walks of life but in a different idiom. It is another beautiful song.
quotes.speaker: Ellis T. Rasmussen
